headline: Public hearing on a Class II license request for Mass Garage LLC at 99 Worcester Providence Tpke.
summary: Scheduling a special town meeting is also on the list. Updates on the FY28 budget and the town manager are on the agenda too.

# COMMONWEALTH OF MASSACHUSETTS

## Town of Sutton

Pursuant to GL Chapter 30A, §§ 18-25 you are hereby notified of a meeting which includes the agenda

**Board/Committee:** Select Board meeting

**Date:** November 24, 2026

**Time:** 6:00 P.M. Regular Meeting

Location: This meeting will be held **in-person** at the Sutton Town Hall Room 1A or virtually by using the online **Zoom** application at http://zoom.us/join or via phone at #1-929-205-6099 US (New York) using Meeting ID: 850 5293 8721 / Passcode: 367680

**Please note** that while an option for remote attendance and/or participation is being provided as a courtesy to the public, the meeting/hearing will not be suspended or terminated if technological problems interrupt the virtual broadcast, unless otherwise required by law. Members of the public with particular interest in any specific item on this agenda should make plans for in-person vs. virtual attendance accordingly

Call to Order / Pledge of Allegiance

Public Forum

1. Select Board Meeting Minutes: November 10, 2026

2. \*Public Hearing\* Class II License request- Mass Garage LLC- applicant Ali Katlav- 99 Worcester Providence Tpke.

3. Schedule Special Town Meeting

4. FY28 Budget Update

5. Town Manager Update

6. Announcements/Select board Round table/Correspondence

## Adjournment

\*\*NOTE\*\* The meeting will be recorded and televised on local public access stations (Verizon 31 & Charter/Spectrum 191) and live streamed on the Towns YouTube channel when available. A recording will be available on the Town's website at www.suttonma.org after proceedings
